verdict.rationale: Sift's docs list Payment Protection alongside Account Takeover, Account Abuse (fake accounts), Promotion Abuse and Content Integrity as distinct products. Each gets an abuse-specific risk score, so several fraud types can be fought at once. They are all managed in one place through Workflows, Review Queues and custom Decisions such as Ban Account. missing for 10: explicit evidence for policy abuse (e.g., refund/return abuse) beyond promotion abuse, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-abuse coverage in a single system.
